nodes.label: Read before acting. The agent must read agent.md at the start of every session to establish context. For deeper tasks, the agent must look up the relevant files from the registry.
nodes.norm_label: read before acting. the agent must read agent.md at the start of every session to establish context. for deeper tasks, the agent must look up the relevant files from the registry.

nodes.label: Update only on request. The agent will register new files, enforce ownership, and keep the registry accurate only when the human explicitly requests a "doc sweep" after approving code changes.
nodes.norm_label: update only on request. the agent will register new files, enforce ownership, and keep the registry accurate only when the human explicitly requests a "doc sweep" after approving code changes.

nodes.label: The human checkpoint is the system. The agent cannot catch if wrong behavior is approved; it trusts the human's confirmation. Garbage in, garbage out.
nodes.norm_label: the human checkpoint is the system. the agent cannot catch if wrong behavior is approved; it trusts the human's confirmation. garbage in, garbage out.
